meaning.ur: Cooling fan atka.

causes.ur: Dust ya bearing kharab

causes.en: Fan wiring open or connector loose
causes.ur: Fan ki wiring khuli ho ya connector dhila ho
Fan capacitor ya motor kharab ho

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply and isolate the unit before touching the fan.
solutions.ur: Fan ko touch karne se pehle AC supply band karke unit ko isolate karein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan blade by hand; if it is stuck by dust or a worn bearing, clear the dust and free it.
solutions.ur: Fan blade haath se ghumaayein, agar dust ya kharab bearing se atka ho toh saaf karke azaad karein.

solutions.en: If the fan still does not run, replace the fan or its capacitor, then restore supply and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Fan phir bhi na chale toh fan ya uska capacitor badlein, phir supply wapas karke confirm karein ke fault khatam ho gaya.

source.title: InfiniSolar FCS 3.6/5.6 hybrid user manual (local extract fcs_infini.pdf — no Knox badge)

meaning.ur: Converter ka temperature zyada hai

causes.ur: Vents band ya gandi
Cooling fan chal nahi raha
Heavy load se unit garam ho rahi hai

solutions.en: Turn off the AC supply and let the unit cool down before opening it.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC supply band karke unit ko thanda hone dein, uske baad hi kholein.

solutions.en: Clear the blocked vents and check the cooling fan is running and the air around the unit is not hot.
solutions.ur: Band vents saaf karein aur check karein ke fan chal raha ho aur unit ke aas paas ka temperature zyada na ho.

solutions.en: If the temperature still rises, the fan or thermal sensor is faulty — replace the failed part and retest.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi temperature barhe toh fan ya thermal sensor kharab hota hai — kharab part badlein aur dobara check karein.

meaning.ur: Battery over-charge ho jati hai

causes.ur: Battery type ya qty ghalat

causes.en: Battery electrolyte low or cells weak
causes.ur: Battery ka electrolyte kam ho ya cells kamzor hon

solutions.en: Check battery type/qty vs program settings and terminal tightness
solutions.ur: Battery type/qty program setting se milayein aur terminals tight karein

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Band karein; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required

meaning.ur: Output window se bahar.

causes.ur: Grid ya output stage masla

causes.en: Grid voltage or frequency out of range
causes.ur: Grid ka voltage ya frequency range se bahar ho

causes.en: Feedback component drifted on control board
causes.ur: Control board par feedback component drift kar raha hai

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and isolate the AC supply before probing any output wiring.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur kisi bhi output wiring ko check karne se pehle AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Meter the output voltage and compare it with the setting; also check input/grid voltage and terminal tightness.
solutions.ur: Meter se output voltage napa karke setting se compare karein, aur input/grid voltage aur terminals ki tightness bhi check karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is still out of range, the output/grid stage is faulty — do not keep restarting, send the unit for repair.
solutions.ur: Reading phir bhi range se bahar ho toh output/grid stage kharab hai — baar baar restart na karein, unit repair ke liye bhejein.

meaning.ur: Load ≥110% timer khatam.

causes.ur: Load zyada hai

causes.en: Motor or compressor startup surge too high
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor startup mein surge zyada aa jata hai

causes.en: Load larger than the inverter rating
causes.ur: Load inverter ki rating se zyada ho

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply and reduce the connected load before restarting.
solutions.ur: Restart karne se pehle AC supply band karke connected load kam karein.

solutions.en: Check the total load against the inverter rating; remove heavy appliances so the load stays below the limit.
solutions.ur: Total load inverter ki rating se milayein, zyada wale appliances utaar dein taake load limit se neeche rahe.

solutions.en: Restore the supply and confirm the unit runs without tripping; if it trips again, have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas karke confirm karein ke unit bina trip kiye chal rahi hai, agar dobara trip ho toh unit check karwaein.

meaning.ur: DC bus par over-voltage

causes.ur: Inverter ka andaruni hissa

causes.en: PV array open-circuit voltage too high
causes.ur: PV array ka open-circuit voltage zyada ho

causes.en: Feedback or metering circuit reading wrong
causes.ur: Feedback ya metering circuit reading ghalat de raha ho

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC and PV/battery supply and wait for the DC bus to discharge before any probing.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi probing se pehle AC aur battery supply hata kar DC bus ko discharge hone dein.

solutions.en: Check the input voltage is in range and the metering/feedback wiring is correct; a wrong reading pushes the bus high.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke input voltage range mein hai aur metering/feedback wiring sahi hai, ghalat reading bus ko zyada bana deti hai.

solutions.en: If the bus still overshoots, the feedback or precharge parts are faulty — technician required, replace the failed part and retest.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi bus zyada chala jaye toh feedback ya precharge parts kharab hote hain — technician zaroori hai, kharab part badlein aur dobara check karein.

meaning.ur: Soft-start fail.

causes.ur: Precharge circuit kharab

causes.en: DC bus voltage not reached before start
causes.ur: Start se pehle DC bus voltage pura nahi bana
Precharge relay ya resistor kharab ho

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the AC supply, then wait a few minutes before retrying.
solutions.ur: Power band karke AC supply alag kar dein, dobara start karne se pehle kuch minute ruk jayein.

solutions.en: Check the battery/PV input voltage and precharge circuit connections; low input or an open precharge path stops the soft start.
solutions.ur: Battery/PV input voltage aur precharge circuit ki connections check karein, voltage kam ho ya precharge path khula ho toh soft start nahi hoga.

solutions.en: Restore supply and retry; if soft start fails again, the precharge relay or control board is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas karke phir try karein, soft start dobara fail ho toh precharge relay ya control board kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.ur: Output soft-start fail.

causes.ur: Output stage ka masla
Output relay pick nahi kar rahi
Soft start ke waqt load laga hua ho

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the AC supply before checking the output stage.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karke AC supply alag kar dein, output stage check karne se pehle.

solutions.en: Inspect the output wiring and relay for loose or burnt connections with the supply isolated.
solutions.ur: Supply alag hone par output wiring aur relay ke loose ya jale hue connections visually check karein.

solutions.en: Restore supply, retry the soft start and meter the output; if it still fails, replace the failed part and retest.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas karke soft start dobara try karein aur meter se output napaayein, phir bhi fail ho toh kharab part badlein aur dobara check karein.

title.en: Over DC offset in AC output
title.ur: AC output mein DC offset zyada

meaning.ur: AC output par DC offset.

causes.ur: Output stage ka masla
Output MOSFET ya IGBT leak kar raha ho

causes.en: Current sensor zero drift on control board
causes.ur: Control board par current sensor zero drift kar raha ho

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate the AC supply before probing the output.
solutions.ur: Output ko check karne se pehle inverter band karke AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Meter the DC component across the AC output terminals; there should be no significant DC present.
solutions.ur: AC output terminals par DC component meter se napain, wahan koi zyada DC nahi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If DC is present, the output stage is faulty — do not keep restarting, send for repair and replace the failed part.
solutions.ur: Agar DC mil raha hai toh output stage kharab hai — baar baar restart na karein, repair ke liye bhejein aur kharab part badlein.

meaning.ur: Current sensor fail.

causes.ur: Current sensor kharab

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or pin damaged
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dhila ho ya pin tooti ho
Sensor ki wiring chassis se touch kar rahi ho

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply and open the unit before checking the current sensor.
solutions.ur: Current sensor check karne se pehle AC supply band karke unit kholein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector for looseness or damage and compare its reading with a clamp meter; a flat reading means it has failed.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka connector dhila ya toota hua hai toh theek karein, aur uska reading clamp meter se compare karein, reading zero aaye toh sensor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace the failed current sensor, restore the supply and confirm the fault code clears on test.
solutions.ur: Kharab current sensor badlein, supply wapas karke test par fault code khatam ho jaye yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: Meter the output voltage and compare it with the setting; also check input/grid supply and tightness of output connections.

solutions.en: If voltage is still low, the output stage or feedback path is faulty — do not keep restarting, technician/repair centre required.
solutions.ur: Voltage phir bhi kam ho toh output stage ya feedback path kharab hai — baar baar restart na karein, technician/repair centre zaroori.

meaning.ur: Power feedback protection — parallel setup ka fault

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat
Parallel cable ulti ya dhili lagi ho

causes.en: External source feeding power back to the output
causes.ur: Bahar se source ka power output par wapas aa raha ho

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the AC supply before checking parallel cabling or settings.
solutions.ur: Parallel cabling ya setting check karne se pehle power band karke AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel/setup configuration matches on every unit and the parallel/communication cables are seated properly.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke har unit ki parallel/setup configuration ek jaisi hai aur parallel/communication cables theek se lagi hui hain.

solutions.en: Restore supply and retest; if the code returns, the control board or feedback wiring is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas karke dobara check karein, code phir aaye toh control board ya feedback wiring kharab hai — technician zaroori.

source.title: InfiniSolar FCS 3.6/5.6 hybrid user manual (local extract fcs_infini.pdf — no Knox badge)

meaning.ur: Firmware version alag hai — parallel setup ka fault

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: One unit upgraded and the others not
causes.ur: Ek unit upgrade ho gayi ho aur baaki na ho

causes.en: Mixed firmware versions from the factory
causes.ur: Factory se mixed firmware versions aaye hon

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply before connecting a laptop or touching the control board.
solutions.ur: Laptop lagane se pehle AC supply alag kar dein, aur control board ko touch karne se bhi pehle.

solutions.en: Read the firmware version on every parallel unit and update any unit whose version does not match the rest.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka firmware version padhein, jo unit ka version baaki se alag ho use update karein.

solutions.en: After updating, power up the whole system again and confirm the fault stays cleared.
solutions.ur: Update ke baad poora system dobara start karke confirm karein ke fault ab nahi aa raha.

source.title: InfiniSolar FCS 3.6/5.6 hybrid user manual (local extract fcs_infini.pdf — no Knox badge)

meaning.ur: Current sharing ka fault — parallel setup masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: One unit carrying more load than the others
causes.ur: Ek unit baaki units se zyada load le rahi ho
Sharing cable ya breaker dhila ho

solutions.en: Turn off the AC supply of all parallel units before checking the sharing wiring.
solutions.ur: Sharing wiring check karne se pehle saare parallel units ki AC supply band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check each unit carries a similar share of the load and that output breakers and cables are not loose.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke har unit par load barabar aata ho aur output breakers ya cables dhile na hon.

solutions.en: Retest after tightening connections; if the fault remains, the sharing circuit on one unit is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Connections tight karke phir check karein, fault ab bhi rahe toh ek unit ka sharing circuit kharab hai — technician zaroori.

source.title: InfiniSolar FCS 3.6/5.6 hybrid user manual (local extract fcs_infini.pdf — no Knox badge)

meaning.ur: CAN bus ka fault — parallel setup masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat
Boards ke darmiyan CAN cable khuli ho
Control board ka CAN port kharab ho

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply before re-seating the CAN/communication connectors.
solutions.ur: CAN/communication connectors dobara lagane se pehle AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the CAN wiring and termination between boards for loose pins or damaged cable; compare with a known good unit if available.
solutions.ur: Boards ke darmiyan CAN wiring aur termination check karein, pin dhili ho ya cable tooti ho toh theek karein, available ho toh ache unit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Restore power and retest; if the CAN fault returns, the control board is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Power wapas karke dobara check karein, CAN fault phir aaye toh control board kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.ur: Host ka connection kat gaya — parallel setup masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: Primary unit powered off or tripped
causes.ur: Primary unit band ho gayi ho ya trip kar gayi ho

causes.en: Communication port on primary unit failed
causes.ur: Primary unit ka communication port kharab ho gaya ho

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply before checking the parallel/host link.
solutions.ur: Parallel/host link check karne se pehle AC supply band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the host/primary unit is powered and online and the communication cable is connected at both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke host/primary unit on hai aur online hai, aur communication cable dono taraf lagi ho.

solutions.en: Power up again and confirm the host is detected; if it is still lost, the communication board is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Dobara power up karke confirm karein ke host mil raha hai, phir bhi loss rahe toh communication board kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.ur: Synchronization nahi rahi — parallel setup ka masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: Units out of phase with each other
causes.ur: Units ek doosre ke phase se alag ho gaye hon
Phase sensing wire khuli hui ho

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply before checking the synchronization wiring between parallel units.
solutions.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan synchronization wiring check karne se pehle AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check all units are set to the same phase/source and are not out of step.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saare units ek hi phase/source par set hain aur ek doosre se out of step nahi hain.

solutions.en: Restart the whole system in the correct order; if loss repeats, the sync/control board is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Poore system ko sahi order mein dobara start karein, loss baar baar aaye toh sync/control board kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.ur: Battery voltage units mein alag mili — parallel setup ka masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: Battery settings not the same on all units
causes.ur: Sab units par battery setting ek jaisi nahi ho

causes.en: Battery sense wire loose on one unit
causes.ur: Ek unit par battery sense wire dhili ho

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply and the battery before comparing settings across parallel units.
solutions.ur: Parallel units ki setting compare karne se pehle AC supply aur battery alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage setting on each unit and match the battery type, quantity and voltage on all of them.
solutions.ur: Har unit par battery voltage setting padhein aur sab mein battery type, quantity aur voltage ek jaisa rakhein.

solutions.en: Save the settings, power cycle the system and confirm the fault clears; if not, the control board is faulty.
solutions.ur: Setting save karke system ka power cycle karein aur confirm karein ke fault khatam ho gaya, na ho toh control board kharab hai.

title.ur: AC input voltage/frequency units mein alag mil rahe hain

meaning.en: AC input voltage/frequency detected different — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC input voltage/frequency units mein alag mil rahe — parallel setup ka fault

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: Input sensing of one unit reading wrong
causes.ur: Ek unit ki input sensing ghalat kar rahi ho

causes.en: Input breaker or wiring loose on one unit
causes.ur: Ek unit ka input breaker ya wiring dhila ho

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply before checking the input wiring of each parallel unit.
solutions.ur: Har parallel unit ki input wiring check karne se pehle AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Meter the AC input voltage and frequency on every unit and compare them; all units should read the same supply.
solutions.ur: Har unit par meter se AC input voltage aur frequency napa karke compare karein, sab units ko ek hi supply honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Restore supply and retest; if readings still differ, the input sensing circuit is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas karke phir check karein, reading phir bhi alag aaye toh input sensing circuit kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.en: AC output current unbalance — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC output current barabar nahi — parallel setup masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat
Load phases par barabar nahi banta ho
Ek output phase ka connection dhila ho

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply and isolate the unit before checking output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output wiring check karne se pehle AC supply band karke unit isolate karein.

solutions.en: Clamp each output phase and compare the currents; an uneven reading points to a loose connection or one weak phase.
solutions.ur: Har output phase ko clamp meter se napa karke compare karein, reading barabar na aaye toh connection dhila ho sakta hai ya ek phase kamzor ho.

solutions.en: Tighten the connections and retest; if the unbalance stays, the output stage on one phase is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Connections tight karke phir check karein, phir bhi barabar na ho toh ek phase ka output stage kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.en: AC output mode setting different — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC output mode setting units mein alag hai — parallel setup masla

causes.ur: Parallel setup ya configuration ghalat

causes.en: Output mode not saved the same on all units
causes.ur: Sab units par output mode same save nahi ho

causes.en: Setting changed on one unit only
causes.ur: Sirf ek unit ki setting badli gayi ho

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply before changing any parallel/output mode setting.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi parallel/output mode setting badalne se pehle AC supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check every parallel unit has the same AC output mode setting and save it after changing.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke har unit ka AC output mode setting ek jaisa ho aur badalne ke baad save kar lein.

solutions.en: Power cycle the system and confirm the fault clears; if it returns, the setting does not hold — technician required.
solutions.ur: System ka power cycle karein aur confirm karein ke fault khatam ho gaya, wapas aaye toh setting save nahi hoti — technician zaroori.
